abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 4. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |

| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 101 | 400 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 149 | 400 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 109 | 400 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 131 | 400 |
